description: This PHP source file is a controller class for handling user account downloads in an OpenCart-based e-commerce system. It manages the listing and download of files, including authorization checks, rendering views, and serving file content.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: A controller class in the OpenCart framework responsible for listing downloadable files to authenticated users and serving the files as downloads.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the downloads list page, including pagination, breadcrumbs, and links to individual files.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles serving individual download files to authenticated users, performing file existence and permission checks, and managing HTTP headers for file transfer.
